app.title: Graded Reader Level Adjuster
set.title: Display settings
font.loading: Loading font. The first time may take a moment…
font.ready: Using “{name}”. Words in the TBCL list show the correct reading for characters with several pronunciations.
font.missing: “{name}” was not found. Install the ToneOZ font on this computer, or ask the administrator to set a font URL.
out.note: The interface language only changes buttons and help text. Analysis, revised text and reports are always in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan).
level.meta: About {words} words and {chars} characters in total · sentences ≤{len} characters | {type}
level.meta.nolen: About {words} words and {chars} characters in total | {type}
type.1: Words, set phrases, very short Q&A
type.6: Long texts on abstract and specialized topics
type.7: Professional and academic texts, formal written style
mode.label: Adjustment
learner.label: Learner
learner.adult_char: Adult, character background (Japan, Korea…), in Taiwan
text.placeholder:
Paste or type a Chinese text here, one chapter at a time, up to 3,000 characters.
Dialogues can keep speaker labels such as 「小美：」.

To see how it works, press “Load sample” below.
more.summary: More options: protected words, known words, glossary, notes
protected.label: Words that must not change
protected.hint: Names, places, shops, key topic words; one per line or separated by 、. Words on the “專名” sheet are added automatically.
known.label: Words the learner already knows (count as known even above level)
glossary.label: Book glossary (may stay; counts toward coverage)
notes.label: Extra instructions for the AI
notes.ph: e.g. keep first-person narration; at most four sentences per paragraph. (Please write in Chinese)
strip.label: Dialogue: remove speaker labels at line start (e.g. 「王老師：」) before counting
hint.adjust: Adjusting takes about 20–60 seconds. Each rewrite round is one AI call, up to {r} rounds.
hint.noai: Adjusting becomes available after the administrator adds an API key.
busy.analyze: Segmenting and counting with the TBCL list…
busy.adjust: AI is rewriting to level {n}. The result will be re-checked with the word list
foot.basis: Levels follow the National Academy for Educational Research’s Taiwan Benchmarks for the Chinese Language (TBCL). The TOCFL mapping is overall and may differ by one level per skill. Coverage thresholds and sentence lengths are rules of thumb.
err.backend: Backend not found. Open this page from the Apps Script web app URL.
err.noText: Paste or type a text first.
err.tooLong: The text is over the {max}-character limit for one adjustment. Adjust one chapter at a time.
dir.polish: keep the level, fix usage and naturalness only
chart.curve.aside: Where it meets the threshold = reading level
chart.tip: Up to level {n} + glossary and names: {c}%
chart.lv.title: Level {n} ({band}): {tok} tokens, {types} word types
chart.support.title: Names/protected {p}, glossary {g}, known {k}, numerals {num}
chart.oov.title: Fragments not in the word list
read.title: Marked text
read.aside: Hover a word to see its level
tip.speaker: Speaker label (not counted)
iss.oov: Fragments not in the word list
iss.oov.aside: May be names, segmentation errors, above-level words or typos. Add names to protected words
rev.use: Put back in the text box
rev.text.aside: Words still above level are marked in red
chg.note: “Not found” means the original wording given by the AI does not appear in the text (it may have paraphrased or merged sentences). Compare with the revised text.
gl.note.adj: Words in the revised text still above the target level, plus words the AI kept on purpose.
gl.note.an: Words above the target level found by the analysis (before adjusting).
gl.note.py: Pinyin and zhuyin come from the TBCL reference columns; for blanks, check the MOE Concised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary.
md.note: Paste straight into Google Docs, Notion or HackMD.
